limits: Original totals are shell real values; current totals are GNU resource.time elapsed values, rounded to 0.01 second.
A frozen candidate library is reproducible now, but no saved historical per-run library/model hash proves it was loaded in May.
Original read/trial splits are absent. Current compute gaps are measured, not proven matches to original compute gaps.
One pair per changed setting and drift between baseline pairs prevent interpreting nearest observed pair as a reproducible tuning effect.
Same-boot sessions share a live host history. Full preparation does not restore memory placement or all cache state.
Manifest limitations inherited from the original graph-cache-only runner are stale for sessions with condition_preset may04_full; use recorded preparation and preset.
No ranking reward or penalty is assigned to accounting correctness or an assumed causal mechanism.
